name: Repoevo – Plugin Analytics, Keyword Tracking & Competitor Monitoring
author: achimschmid

sections.description:
Why are your downloads dropping — and you have no idea why?

You published your plugin on WordPress.org. You’re getting some downloads. But you don’t know why people find you, who is beating you in search results, or what your real growth trend looks like.

You’re flying blind.

Repoevo changes that.

Repoevo is the dedicated plugin monitoring and analytics dashboard built exclusively for WordPress plugin developers, agencies and indie makers. It tracks everything that matters — downloads, active installs, keyword rankings, conversion rates and competitor performance — directly inside your WordPress admin.

No spreadsheets. No manual work. No guessing.

The problem with WordPress.org plugin analytics

WordPress.org gives you almost nothing. A download count. A rough install number. That’s it.

You can’t see:
* Which keywords your plugin ranks for on WordPress.org
* Why your downloads spiked — or crashed — after an update
* Which competitors are stealing your installs
* What your real conversion rate is
* Whether your plugin is growing or slowly dying

Repoevo gives you all of this — for free.

📊 Plugin Analytics & Download Tracking

Finally understand your plugin’s real performance. As a performance monitoring and data-visualization WordPress plugin, Repoevo turns raw numbers into charts you can actually read at a glance:

  • Total downloads and daily download trends — visualized with beautiful charts
  • Active installs tracking — see your real install base grow over time
  • Conversion rate — how many people download your plugin actually install it?
  • Version-based performance analysis — did your last update help or hurt?
  • Baseline trend line — see your real download baseline, smoothed out from spikes and events
  • Rating and review tracking — monitor your plugin’s reputation over time

This is the WordPress plugin analytics dashboard you always needed — and never had.

🏆 Keyword Ranking & WordPress.org SEO

Most plugin developers have no idea how WordPress.org search works. Repoevo changes that.

  • Track your WordPress.org tag rankings over time — see exactly where you rank for every keyword
  • Full ranking history — watch your positions rise and fall across weeks and months
  • Automatic keyword discovery — Repoevo finds keywords your plugin already ranks for, even if you never tracked them
  • Custom keyword monitoring — add any keyword and track your ranking position daily
  • Identify untapped ranking opportunities — find keywords you’re close to ranking for
  • Trend visualization — see which keywords are moving up and which are fading

Combined with ongoing keyword-analysis, this gives you a clear picture of how WordPress.org search really ranks your plugin. If you want more downloads, you need better keyword rankings on WordPress.org. Repoevo’s position tracking gives you full rank tracking and shows you exactly where you stand.

🤝 Competitor Analysis & Benchmarking

Your competitors are growing. Do you know how?

  • See which plugins compete for your keywords — know your real competition
  • Compare rankings, downloads and installs side by side — benchmark yourself against any plugin
  • Monitor competitor growth over time — spot trends before they become threats
  • Add any WordPress.org plugin to your dashboard with one click — not just your own
  • Conversion rate comparison — find out if competitors convert better than you — and why
  • Direct chart overlay — compare download trends and keyword rankings visually with any monitored plugin

Stop ignoring your competition. Start learning from them.

📈 Version & Growth Tracking

Every update you ship changes your download trend. Most developers never know if it helped or hurt.

With Repoevo you can:

  • Compare plugin performance across versions — see exactly what each update did to your numbers
  • Detect the exact impact of changelogs on download and install trends
  • Measure growth week by week and month by month
  • Spot the moment things went wrong — and fix it fast

📄 PDF Export — Built for Agencies

Running WordPress plugins for clients? Repoevo’s PDF export turns your analytics into a professional client report in one click.

  • Clean, branded PDF analytics report — ready to send to clients
  • Includes download chart, keyword ranking chart and key stats
  • Available on Pro and Business plans

No more copying numbers into spreadsheets. Just export and send.

⚡ Smart, Lightweight & Automatic

Repoevo works silently in the background — no setup, no manual data entry.

  • Fully automatic data collection — Repoevo fetches fresh data daily, you do nothing
  • Intelligent cache system — instant load times even with large datasets
  • Plugin icons cached locally — no repeated external requests to WordPress.org
  • Lightweight and performance-optimized — zero impact on your site’s front end
  • Clean, modern WordPress admin interface — feels like it belongs in WordPress

Who is Repoevo for?

Plugin developers who want to grow their WordPress.org presence, understand their keyword rankings and finally know why their download numbers go up — or down.

WordPress agencies who manage plugins for clients and need a professional way to report download trends, keyword rankings and growth metrics — without manual work.

Indie makers who publish plugins on WordPress.org and want to discover untapped keyword opportunities, track competitor performance and grow faster.

Competitor researchers who want to benchmark any plugin on WordPress.org — rankings, installs, conversion rates and growth trends.

What makes Repoevo different?

Repoevo combines WordPress.org plugin analytics, keyword ranking tracking, competitor monitoring and PDF export in a single WordPress plugin — installed directly in your admin dashboard, with automatic daily data collection and zero manual work.

Repoevo is built by a WordPress developer, for WordPress developers.

Features

  • Monitor any WordPress.org plugin — your own or any competitor
  • Daily download tracking with trend charts
  • Baseline trend line — smoothed download curve to reveal your real performance level
  • Active installs tracking over time
  • Conversion rate monitoring (downloads vs. installs)
  • Version-based performance analysis
  • WordPress.org keyword and tag ranking tracking
  • Full keyword ranking history and trend visualization
  • Rich chart visualizations for downloads, installs and keyword rankings
  • Automatic keyword discovery — find rankings you didn’t know about
  • Custom keyword monitoring with daily position updates
  • WordPress.org search visibility tracking across all your keywords
  • Competitor plugin comparison and benchmarking
  • Side-by-side chart overlay — compare downloads and keyword rankings directly
  • Rating and review tracking
  • PDF export for analytics and client reports (Pro & Business)
  • Intelligent cache system for fast load times
  • Local icon caching — plugin icons stored locally, no repeated external requests
  • Chart visibility settings saved per user — remembered across devices and sessions
  • Support tab — contact support directly from the plugin
  • Redesigned settings page with onboarding flow and connection status
  • Automatic redirect to settings after plugin activation
  • Clean, modern and lightweight WordPress admin interface
  • Available in English and German

External Services

This plugin connects to an external API to retrieve monitoring and analytics data.

Service provider: Webagentur BGL
Service URL: https://api.webagentur-bgl.com
Privacy Policy: https://repoevo.com/datenschutzerklaerung/
Terms of Service: https://repoevo.com/agb/

Data sent:
* Plugin slugs of monitored plugins
* Analysis timestamps (last known analysis time per plugin)
* Site URL (only when connecting an API key)

Data usage:
The transmitted data is used exclusively to provide analytics, monitoring and update detection features. No personal user data is collected or transmitted. The external API is required for the core functionality of this plugin.

Chart.js is loaded locally and used to render analytics charts within the plugin dashboard. No data is sent to Chart.js or any CDN.

Source Code

This plugin includes minified JavaScript files compiled from source files located in assets/js/admin/ within the plugin directory. The unminified source files are included in the plugin package.

Third-party libraries included locally:
* Chart.js (https://www.chartjs.org/) — MIT License
* chartjs-plugin-annotation (https://www.chartjs.org/chartjs-plugin-annotation/) — MIT License
* html2canvas (https://html2canvas.hertzen.com/) — MIT License
* jsPDF (https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF) — MIT License

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress plugin manager
  3. You will be redirected automatically to the settings page
  4. Click Connect for free — your license will be linked to your site URL
  5. Add any WordPress.org plugin slug and start monitoring immediately

No configuration needed. Data collection starts automatically.
sections.faq:
Is Repoevo free?

Yes. Core features including download tracking, install tracking, conversion rate and keyword ranking are completely free. Pro and Business plans unlock custom keyword tracking, PDF export and monitoring for more plugins.

What can I monitor with Repoevo?

Any plugin from the official WordPress.org repository — your own plugins or any competitor’s plugin. Just enter the plugin slug and Repoevo starts collecting data automatically.

How does keyword ranking tracking work?

Repoevo tracks your plugin’s position in WordPress.org search results for your tags and custom keywords — daily. You can see your full ranking history, spot trends and discover keywords you didn’t even know you ranked for.

Does Repoevo show keywords I am not tracking yet?

Yes. Repoevo automatically discovers keywords your plugin already ranks for in the WordPress.org search results — even if you never added them manually. Pro users see the exact ranking positions for all discovered keywords.

Can I track competitor plugins?

Yes. You can add any public WordPress.org plugin to your Repoevo dashboard and monitor its downloads, installs, keyword rankings and conversion rate — side by side with your own plugins.

Can I compare two plugins directly in the charts?

Yes. In the detail view you can select any other monitored plugin as a comparison. Download trends and keyword rankings are overlaid directly in the same chart — your plugin as a solid line, the comparison as a dashed line in the same color.

Can I export my analytics as a PDF?

Yes. Pro and Business users can export a complete analytics report as a clean PDF directly from the dashboard — including the download chart, keyword ranking chart and key statistics. Perfect for client reporting.

How often is data updated?

Repoevo collects fresh data daily. The intelligent cache system ensures instant load times while keeping your data up to date.

My license is not working on another site. Why?

Each Repoevo license is linked to the site URL entered when you first connected. You can see exactly which URL your license is linked to on the Settings page. If you need to use Repoevo on a different site, disconnect and reconnect on that site.

Does this affect my site’s performance?

No. All data processing happens in the background. The plugin has zero impact on your site’s front-end performance.

Where can I find the documentation?

Full documentation is available at https://repoevo.com/docs/
sections.changelog:
1.7.1

  • Fix: Momentum box could show contradicting labels at the same time (e.g. “recovering” headline next to “speeding up” in the Acceleration tile) — the Acceleration tile now always states clearly whether the improvement or the decline is easing or speeding up.

1.7.0

  • New: Momentum score — a leading indicator showing the direction of your keyword rankings (velocity, breadth and acceleration) days before it shows up in downloads, with its own chart in the detail view (Pro/Business)
  • New: 5-day free Pro trial — try Momentum charts, discovered-keyword positions and PDF export once, no credit card required, from a one-time prompt or the Upgrade tab
  • Improvement: Sticky action bar for filter, compare and PDF export in the detail view, plus contextual help (“?”) popups on charts and key sections
  • Improvement: “Plugin comparison” toggle can now track a competitor plugin directly from the detail view for Pro/Business users
  • Fix: Upgrade tab and pricing checkout now correctly stay available for your actual plan while a Pro trial is active, instead of appearing already upgraded

1.6.1

  • Fix: Change-tracking badges (installs, rating, version, keyword rankings, discovered keywords) were not reliably detected when new data arrived — diff detection is now recalculated on every data refresh instead of being tied to the daily snapshot cycle, so discovered-keyword ranking changes in particular are no longer missed.
  • Fix: Review reminder icon briefly rendered oversized before styles finished loading — icon now has explicit dimensions so it always displays at the correct size.

1.6.0

  • New: Change tracking in the detail view — when new data arrives, delta badges show what changed since the last data snapshot: active installs, rating, number of ratings, plugin version and keyword ranking movements (climbed/dropped positions, new in or dropped out of the Top 100) — shown in the stat cards, the discovered-keywords list and the keyword ranking legend
  • New: Review reminder — a dismissible prompt asks active users for a WordPress.org review after real usage (appears only after you’ve monitored a plugin for a few days; snooze or dismiss anytime)
  • SEO: readme.txt tags and description refined for better WordPress.org search visibility

1.5.0

  • New: Baseline line in downloads chart — Gaussian-weighted moving average shows your real download level, independent of spikes or events
  • New: Chart visibility saved per user across devices — show/hide lines in both charts and settings are remembered server-side (no longer device-specific)
  • New: Version and Installs annotations can be toggled on/off in both charts via the legend — state is saved per user
  • New: Support tab — contact support directly from the plugin with a pre-filled form including plan, plugins and site context
  • Improvement: Chart lines no longer show individual data points — cleaner visualization with full hover tooltip support
  • Improvement: Hover tooltip now appears when moving near the line, not just on exact data points
  • Fix: Chart visibility in comparison mode no longer conflicts with Plugin B keyword filter

1.4.1

  • Fix: “Add” button in “Monitor new plugin” section was missing English translation — now correctly internationalized
  • Fix: Mobile — keyword ranking chart and legend were displayed side by side, now stacked vertically
  • Fix: Mobile — “Keyword Ranking (Top 100)” title wrapped across multiple lines due to input field next to it — now stacked
  • Fix: Mobile — custom keyword input field now uses full width
  • SEO: readme.txt tags optimized for better WordPress.org search ranking
  • Compatibility: Tested up to WordPress 7.0

1.4.0

  • New: Direct chart overlay — compare any two monitored plugins in the same download and keyword ranking chart
  • New: Keyword matching indicator — see which keywords both plugins rank for, with ranking positions shown in the legend
  • New: Onboarding redesign — settings page now shows step-by-step connection flow with live status
  • New: Activation redirect — plugin automatically redirects to settings after activation
  • New: License URL display — settings page shows exactly which site URL the license is linked to
  • New: Local icon caching — plugin icons are downloaded and cached locally, no repeated requests to WordPress.org
  • New: Icons automatically refreshed when new API data is received
  • New: Keyword notice now appears inline next to the chart instead of at the top of the page
  • New: Custom keywords appear in the legend immediately after adding, before API data is available
  • Improvement: Compare dropdown repositioned next to Daily Downloads title for better usability
  • Improvement: Non-matching keywords automatically hidden when comparison plugin is active
  • Improvement: Custom keywords no longer displayed as dashed lines in keyword ranking chart
  • Fix: Nonce added to competitor detail links — security check no longer fails
  • Fix: Y-axis in keyword chart now correctly scales to include comparison plugin rankings
  • Fix: Keywords already stored locally but missing from API now correctly re-synced on next add attempt
  • Fix: API connect notice now displayed inline in settings card instead of at top of page
  • Fix: Plugin notices (reconnect, register) now displayed inline in plugin list instead of at top of page

1.3.0

  • New: Full internationalization (i18n) — plugin now available in English and German
  • New: German (de_DE) translation included
  • New: English set as default language for international users

1.2.1

  • Fix: Unique install ID introduced — localhost installations no longer share the same license

1.2.0

  • New: PDF Export — export full analytics report as PDF (Pro & Business)
  • New: Upgrade page — redesigned plan comparison with full feature overview
  • Fix: Chart height no longer overflows into next section on wider viewports

1.1.4

  • Fix: Keyword ranking legend now correctly displays “>100” when plugin is not ranked in Top 100
  • Fix: Download trend line no longer extends into negative values

1.1.3

  • Fix: Plan changes (upgrade/downgrade) now instantly reflected in detail view
  • Fix: Range filter (3 months, 6 months) no longer triggers security error
  • Fix: Plan always loaded fresh from API — cache no longer serves stale plan data

1.1.2

  • Security: Nonce verification added for detail view
  • Security: All echoed variables properly escaped
  • Code: Unique repoevo_ prefix applied throughout
  • Fix: Plan changes now correctly reflected in detail view

1.1.1

  • Fix: Plugins with status “not monitored” (plan limit) can now be reconnected directly from the dashboard with one click

1.1.0

  • New: Discovered Keywords — automatically detects keywords your plugin ranks for
  • New: Collapsible sections for Discovered Keywords and Plugin Comparison
  • New: Pro feature — unlock exact ranking positions for discovered keywords
  • Improvement: Cache system optimized with ranking-based expiry times

1.0.1

  • Security: Nonce verification enforced for keyword actions
  • Fix: Nonce passed correctly via JavaScript form submission

1.0.0

  • Initial release
